english.title: Conspire to do an act to facilitate the commission of a breach of UK immigration law by a non UK national
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) conspired together with

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSONS..)]_
(C)_[another person]_
(D)_[other persons]_

to do an act, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ACT..), which facilitated the commission of

(E)_[a breach]_
(F)_[an attempted breach]_

of immigration law, namely **(..SPECIFY THE BREACH..), by a person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), who was not a national of the United Kingdom, knowing or having reasonable cause for believing that the act facilitated the commission of

(G)_[a breach]_
(H)_[an attempted breach]_

of immigration law by that person and that the person was not a national of the United Kingdom
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Criminal Law Act 1977.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) On the 28th June 2022, the penalty for offences under this section was increased on indictment from a maximum of 14 years imprisonment to life imprisonment by section 41 of the Nationality and Borders Act 2022. For the offence applying after this date, see H100719.
(ii) The offence is in force from 23:00 on 31st December 2020.
(iii) For offences committed before that date, the offence covers facilitation of breaches of immigration law by persons who are not citizens of the European Union, see H6918/IM71104C.
